<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="photoGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D0CECD"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#939393"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".16"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="92" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="23" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="328" y1="18" x2="328" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="333" y1="16" x2="333" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="14" x2="338" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="19" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="19" x2="353" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="360" y="14" width="19" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="362" y="16" width="14" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="380" y="17" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- top controls -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="27,57 19,65 27,73" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="42" y="70" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="303" y="48" width="67" height="32" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity=".22"/>
    <text x="336.5" y="69" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">DONE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- tabs -->
  <rect x="18" y="82" width="354" height="48" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="105" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">EDIT</text>
  <text x="285" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">PREVIEW</text>
  <rect x="215" y="125" width="70" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>

  <!-- profile card shadow and body -->
  <rect x="18" y="146" width="354" height="529" rx="24" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".10"/>
  <rect x="18" y="143" width="354" height="529" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- profile photo -->
  <rect x="30" y="155" width="330" height="315" rx="21" fill="url(#photoGradient)"/>
  <circle cx="311" cy="190" r="23" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity=".90"/>
  <polyline points="303,190 308,195 320,183" fill="none" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <circle cx="113" cy="250" r="32" fill="#EEEFF1" fill-opacity=".58"/>
  <polygon points="42,427 122,337 181,392 229,345 349,456 349,458 42,458" fill="#939393" fill-opacity=".72"/>
  <polygon points="42,427 122,337 181,392 229,345 349,456 349,458 42,458" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".52" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="113" cy="250" r="11" fill="#EFC54D" fill-opacity=".9"/>
  <rect x="30" y="394" width="330" height="76" rx="0" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".20"/>
  <text x="48" y="430" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">John, 26</text>
  <text x="48" y="452" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">New here · Ready to meet someone</text>

  <!-- profile details -->
  <text x="38" y="501" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">About John</text>
  <text x="38" y="525" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Looking for good conversation, new places,</text>
  <text x="38" y="544" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">and someone who can make me laugh.</text>

  <text x="38" y="579" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Interests</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="38" y="592" width="73" height="29" rx="14.5" fill="#FDE8EF"/>
    <text x="74.5" y="611" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#C42936">MUSIC</text>
    <rect x="119" y="592" width="76" height="29" rx="14.5" fill="#FFF1E8"/>
    <text x="157" y="611" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#C42936">TRAVEL</text>
    <rect x="203" y="592" width="79" height="29" rx="14.5" fill="#FDE8EF"/>
    <text x="242.5" y="611" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#C42936">COFFEE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- preview hint -->
  <line x1="38" y1="644" x2="352" y2="644" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="662" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">This is how your profile appears to others</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="738" width="390" height="106" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="738" x2="390" y2="738" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,771 51,761 63,771 63,784 54,784 54,775 48,775 48,784 39,784" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="51" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">HOME</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="129" cy="771" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M129 766 C125 761 118 765 121 771 L129 779 L137 771 C140 765 133 761 129 766" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="129" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="771" r="19" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="763" x2="195" y2="779" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="187" y1="771" x2="203" y2="771" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#EA5D6B">DISCOVER</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="257" y="762" width="23" height="17" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="261,779 261,784 267,779" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="264" cy="770" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="271" cy="770" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="268.5" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">CHAT</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="337" cy="767" r="6" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="337" cy="781" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#939393"/>
    <path d="M347 758 C351 757 354 760 353 764" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="337" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="150" y="828" width="90" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
</svg>
